name: Howard Lutnick
stance: Recast the AI Safety Institute as CAISI, focused on national-security testing of frontier models rather than broad safety regulation.

statements.text: For far too long, censorship and regulations have been used under the guise of national security. Innovators will no longer be limited by these standards.
Commerce's CAISI signed pre-deployment evaluation agreements with Google DeepMind, Microsoft and xAI to test frontier models for cyber, bio and chemical national-security risks.

review.note: research pass, September 2026; not yet reviewed
